visual_logic.color_palette: Silver-grey skin with buff-colored 'orca-style' patches on the flanks.
visual_logic.environment: Chalky-white water with high visibility and long, horizontal underwater sunbeams cutting straight across the wide frame to establish a clear tracking line.
visual_logic.pose: A full-body horizontal profile view stretching completely from the left edge to the right edge of the frame. The massive, 12-to-13-meter long body is aligned perfectly flat in the lower half of the image, keeping the top half clear so a second species can be drawn or stacked directly above it for side-by-side length comparison. Rather than bending its neck downward toward the seafloor or tilting its tail, its long neck, thick torso, and tail extend out straight and horizontal along the tracking line to showcase its maximum scale.
